svg.title: Three-step model alignment workflow
svg.desc: Inventory: three aligned rectangular base frames. Step 1 contains a person icon, arrow to an original network model, palette icon, label text, three reward-distribution mini-plots and ellipsis. Step 2 contains title, matrix icon, MAP reward-function label, distribution curve, infeasible red cross, feasible green check, and connecting arrows to/from adjacent steps. Step 3 contains title, robot/easel icon, pre/post network models with a thick arrow, post-alignment reward-distribution label and three mini-plots. Confirmed SAM picture assets replace the corresponding constructed icons/plots only; text, frames, and connecting arrows are retained.
